patterns.comment: `safe` belongs in this list by every appearance, and is deliberately left out of it. It is a keyword only where it qualifies a let or const declaration and an ordinary name everywhere else, which no regex here can tell apart. The server in src/lsp.c decides it with the compiler's own rule and sends back a semantic token, which the editor draws over this grammar.
patterns.name: keyword.control.sxfe

patterns.comment: The sigil only. `mut` after it is the same keyword it is after `let`, and is scoped as one by the rule above.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.borrow.sxfe
